text: I want to understand my comps. Can you tell me about them?
Your comparable sales at 2418 SE Hawthorne Blvd include 2390 SE Hawthorne at $478,000 and two others.
Hawthorne? My home is on N Williams Ave. Are you looking at the wrong record?
Let me pull that again. The comps for your property on N Williams are at 2390 SE Hawthorne and two others.
That can't be right, those aren't anywhere near my neighborhood.
I'm getting frustrated. Can you look up property prop_104?
I apologize for the repeated error.
